create_canvas_region: create a CanvasRegion with pixel coordinates divisible by 8 for tiling diffusion outputs
build_text2image_region: build a Text2ImageRegion with a prompt, mask type, and guidance scale for text-guided diffusion
build_image2image_region: build an Image2ImageRegion with a reference tensor and strength for image-guided diffusion
run_stable_diffusion_canvas: run StableDiffusionCanvasPipeline with multiple regions to mix text and image guided diffusion on a canvas
compute_mask_weights: compute Gaussian, quartic, or constant mask weight tensors for blending overlapping diffusion regions
